notes: Read SKILL.md in full (the only file). Research skill that has the agent answer Microsoft-technology questions by querying official documentation through the Microsoft Learn MCP server (microsoft_docs_search / microsoft_docs_fetch), with guidance on writing specific queries and when to fetch full pages.

The agent makes read-only queries to learn.microsoft.com via MCP; if the MCP server is unavailable, SKILL.md:63-70 has it run `npx @microsoft/learn-cli` (downloads and executes the latest CLI from npm, unpinned) or `npm install -g @microsoft/learn-cli`. Medium because of running an unpinned downloaded tool and a global npm install; acceptable because it is Microsoft's official CLI, used only for read-only documentation search/fetch, with no credentials.

Frontmatter has no per-skill `license` field and sets `context: fork`; licensing comes from the repository-root MIT license attached by the review. Search queries are sent to Microsoft Learn, so users should avoid putting sensitive details in queries.
